objectives.title: Group Entity Identification
objectives.description: The contract defines structural specifications for the corporate group.
criteria: Provisions specifying the corporate group structure.
Provisions detailing contact information for each group member.
Provisions identifying individual entities bound by the rules.

objectives.title: Transfer Scope Specifications
objectives.description: The contract details the scope of international data transfers.
criteria: Specifications of personal data categories transferred.
Specifications of processing purposes.
Identification of affected recipient third countries.
Identification of affected data subject types.

objectives.title: Intra-Group Liability Allocation
objectives.description: The contract assigns liability for non-EU member rule breaches.
criteria: Provisions establishing liability for EU-established entities.
Provisions covering damages caused by non-EU group members.
Provisions outlining conditions for liability exemption.

objectives.title: Compliance Auditing Mechanisms
objectives.description: The contract details mechanisms to verify adherence to binding rules.
criteria: Provisions mandating periodic data protection audits.
Provisions requiring corrective action plans for detected issues.
Provisions ensuring audit results are made available to the competent supervisory authority upon request.

objectives.title: Foreign Legal Conflict Notifications
objectives.description: The contract specifies notification mechanisms for foreign legal mandates.
criteria: Provisions requiring identification of third-country legal requirements likely to have a substantial adverse effect on the guarantees provided by the binding corporate rules.
Provisions establishing a mechanism for reporting such legal requirements to the competent supervisory authority.

objectives.title: Enforceable Data Subject Rights and Redress
objectives.description: The contract establishes data subjects' enforceable rights and redress mechanisms under the binding corporate rules.
criteria: Provisions expressly conferring enforceable rights on data subjects with regard to processing under the binding corporate rules.
Provisions enabling data subjects to lodge complaints with the competent supervisory authority or before competent courts for breaches of the binding corporate rules.
Provisions establishing data subjects' right to redress and, where appropriate, compensation for damage caused by a breach of the binding corporate rules.

objectives.title: Personnel Data Protection Training
objectives.description: The contract requires data protection training for personnel with access to personal data.
criteria: Provisions requiring data protection training for personnel with permanent access to personal data.
Provisions requiring data protection training for personnel with regular access to personal data.
Provisions requiring the training to be appropriate to personnel's role and level of data access.
